name: Standalone Demo
description: Counter app demonstrating standalone tools (each tool's HTML registers its own handler), peer.emit, KV proxy, and lazy-open panel

tools.name: increment
tools.description: Increment the counter by a given amount (default 1). Renders a custom +N counter card.

tools.name: read_counter
tools.description: Read the current counter value. Renders the shared simple-result template.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Reset the counter to zero. Renders the shared simple-result template.

tools.name: show_counter
tools.description: Show the counter value in the app's panel UI. Requires the panel.
